photos_h2: What we have been working on

reviews.author: Taylor Wesa
reviews.text: Christian and his crew have been by far the best crew we've worked with at our house for so many reasons. We hired them to cut our overgrown yard (it got away from us this summer) and property, SO GLAD WE DID! Communication is key for us and we've been disappointed in the past by other trades that have come out and helped us on our property. Christian has been THE BEST when proactively communicating when, where and how much jobs will be. Payment is easy. Completed jobs look great. They're great at what they do! We are so relieved to have found his company and we'll continue to hire him and his crew on for more projects.

reviews.author: Caleb Hughes
reviews.text: Owner gets workers to do the work and then refused to pay them. Forces workers to file claims with labor agency for their pay. highstrung, unprofessional owner. Poor communication skills. Foul language. Lousy equipment,mostly broken down. The skill and knowledge comes from the workers not owner.no respect or appreciation shown by owner.

reviews.author: Allison Scholl
reviews.text: COMPLETE DISASTER. He rescheduled several times so by the time he arrives the grass and weeds were completely overgrown. He left in the middle of the job after complaining about how hot it was. Even after providing him with water he said he needed “sugar drinks” so we gave him Mtn Dew. They left without finishing or telling us when they’d be back after filling my trash can with debris and leaving it in the middle of the yard. Texted me FOUR times for payment before coming back to complete the work two days later. After coming back to supposedly complete the work tried to charge me more than 3 times the originally quoted price!! They left the entire side of the yard with 2 foot weeds and thought they did a great job. What a circus. WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND.

reviews.author: David Dillehunt
reviews.text: My wife and I are quite pleased with the outstanding work of Christian’s Lawn Care. Christian and his crew provided excellent, friendly service and were very affordable. We highly recommend Christian’s Lawn Care to anyone in need of landscaping services in Central Virginia!

reviews.author: Tara Carothers
reviews.text: Christian and his crew did an amazing job! They worked tirelessly to transform a yard that had been neglected! I definitely recommend them and will use their services again!

reviews.author: Theresa Bob Lazo
reviews.text: Christian and his company are a wonder. He’s helped us move a two bedroom apartment, take out fallen trees across our driveway, and provided exemplary care of our lawn and grounds there in Charlottesville. I owe Christian a strong debt of gratitude; he’s terrific!

reviews.author: FTC Coord
reviews.text: Christian's Lawn Care did an excellent job weeding our slope and removing briers from Junipers on another slope. Not only was the work excellent, the owner was timely in responding to meeting and supplying a quote, and showing up for the job. It began to rain yet they stayed to complete the job. We value the respectful treatment of our property and a job done well at a reasonable price, and highly recommend this service.

reviews.author: kimberly cunningham
reviews.text: I’ve used this service for two years and in the past he’s been responsive. Did lawn cleanup, tree removal, bed cleanup and lawn maintenance with good results. Unfortunately, this spring I’ve been ghosted. He had been prepaid and only mowed one time all season. No reply to texts, didn’t show up when promised, voicemail full. I just hired another company to do one time yard now as it is almost knee high yet Christian had been paid for services. Still hope he will contact me to resolve and then I will update review.

reviews.author: Anne Galvin
reviews.text: Christian and his team did a great job cleaning our gutters. They were very responsive and even helped point out an issue that hadn't come up in our home inspection. I'd recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Donatella S
reviews.text: The best company ever! I've been so impressed with their knowledge and professionalism. They did a lot of job for past 1,5 year. Christian and his team plant a lot of kinds of flowers in spring and trim bushes and trees in autumn behind our house. Also they cleaned up leaves and powerwash. Everything just came out perfect and our yard have never looked so beautiful like now. Result was amazing!!! I'd highly recommended this company. You won't be disappointed. Thank you so much

reviews.author: Jennifer Williams
reviews.text: We had Christian’s Lawn Care clean out our gutters. They were prompt, professional, and courteous. They found many gutter guards missing and replaced them all. They worked quickly and communicated very well the whole time. I would definitely use them again and recommend them to others!

reviews.author: Courtney Valladares
reviews.text: Working with Christian and his team was fantastic. They cut down three trees in my yard and made sure I was fully satisfied with everything before paying a penny! Christian was always communicating with me and keeping me in the loop with everything going on. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Patti Grieger
reviews.text: Christian and his crew came to our rescue one snowy day and cleared our icy, hilly driveway, they took down an enormous broken tree limb that was threatening our home, and then rebuilt a deck that had been damaged. Christian and his capable crew are very professional, concerned first and foremost with our safety and satisfaction. I can’t recommend them enough and look forward to calling on them for years to come.

reviews.author: Chris Walker
reviews.text: Christian and his work partner arrived at my house at 6 30 am and worked nonstop for 8 hours in hot weather. They sawed off tree limbs, dug up bushes, cleaned off my lower lot, and cleared out a ton of junk growth on my property. I couldn't recommend them more highly. Christian came the day I called, and they did the job a week later. They were fast and thorough and extremely reasonable. Top notch service.

reviews.author: Atul Kannan
reviews.text: I was originally convinced by the good reviews to engage with Christian's Lawn Care, however, my experience was ultimately very unpleasant. I encourage you to the read the critical reviews including this one, and to take them seriously before choosing this company. While the work started out well, I felt the owner was very disrespectful towards his staff and did not do a proper job, particularly with respect to blowing leaves and clearing debris. Moreover, I felt he demonstrated extreme unprofessionalism and did not show up when he said he would. He was also increasingly aggressive and rude towards me when I pointed out deficiencies in his work. I believe that many of these observations are consistent in other critical reviews.

reviews.author: Chr Spina
reviews.text: I have had my lawn done by many different companies over the years, some pretty good & some just terrible. I have to say that this crew is the politest honest & perfessional company I’ve ever had the pleasure of doing business with. The job they did for me far exceeded my expectations. FIVE STARS & 2 thumbs up for owner Jeff & his crew! Thanks again guys. I will be using your service from now on! Very Very happy customer.

reviews.author: susan
reviews.text: Christian and co. came to my house yesterday and trimmed my overgrown hedges for 2 hours. They did an outstanding job shaping the hedges and cleaning up debris. They did more than I had asked for in their alloted 2 hours and the yard appears beautifully landscaped. He graciously waited for me to pay the reasonable cost until the job was done. I will call him for help again, for sure. Thank you, Christian!

reviews.author: Melissa Sabol
reviews.text: Christian’s Lawn Care did a wonderful job removing our leaves and cleaning our gutters. They worked quickly and are very reasonably priced. We will definitely use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Halley Willcox
reviews.text: Christian's Lawn Care service cut down and pine tree that needed to come down. He also trimmed and shaped my Holly's, picked up debris and sticks in the yard and blew my driveway. He was prompt, affordable, quick and extremely easy to work with! I highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Christi Wilson
reviews.text: Starting using their mowing services this summer and we’re very pleased with lawn care and the responsiveness of the owner. He welcomes feedback and communicates regularly to let us know when mowing will occur and if weather conditions change the plan. Very reasonable too!

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.text: Christian and his team did a wonderful job of collecting our leaves. Christian only charged us for 2 hours of work (his original estimated price) even though the job ended up taking 3 hours. He even removed the leaves off of our roof for no extra charge!

reviews.author: Craig Nieb
reviews.text: Had Christian and his crew cut down several dead trees and trim some live trees in my yard. They showed up on time, worked quickly, did exactly as I had asked for and cleaned up the yard nicely. Christian is great to work with and I will use him again.

reviews.author: Owen Farooqui
reviews.text: Chris is easily the best landscaper in town and for an affordable price. Other lawncare companies charge me double what he charges me and the quality is much better. He’s very easy to get in touch with and that was another huge thing for me...he doesnt finish the job and run away, he stays to make sure everything is up to par with your standards and only leaves when its perfect. Using him for all of my properties going forward. Much love Chris, thank you.

reviews.author: Alex Kish
reviews.text: I was pleased with the tree removal service from Christian. I saw his Valpak coupon, called him on a Friday, he came out on Saturday, negotiated a great deal, and was back with his crew later that day to do the job. I would definitely call him again.

reviews.author: Cheryl Yannello
reviews.text: Christian Lawn Care cleaned up fallen trees in the back of my property. He and his helper did a great job, and I am very pleased. I will use his services again. He is very professional and cares about what is done and how it is done.

reviews.author: Vickie G.
reviews.text: Christian and Jorge took down a dead oak that was hanging over part of our house. We requested they fell it in a certain direction to avoid killing other trees and not hitting the house, of course. They put it exactly where we wanted it to go though it was leaning another way. It was a good price too. They are highly recommended if you need trees removed.

reviews.author: Kent Mitchell
reviews.text: Christian's Lawn Care was very responsive to a call placed for estimate and lawn service. He quickly inspected the property and was able to fit us in the following week. Pictures were sent before and after and the place looked great. We could not be happier with Christian's excellent work and customer service

reviews.author: Mackenzie Roberts
reviews.text: Christian did a great job clearing an orchard site for us. He was easy to communicate with, friendly and fast! Great pricing compared to others as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Gerald Beaver
reviews.text: We used this company to surprise our son who was out of town for 6 weeks. The job they did was exceptional and very detailed. We live over 5 hrs. away yet they trusted us to pay when the job was done. We watched videos of the job and Zelled the money to them. Super easy. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: Kevin Weber
reviews.text: When choosing Christians lawn care you are choosing to support a local business owner and not only that but you are choosing to have your individual wants and needs addressed at a an EXTREMELY affordable price. These guys do an amazing job at a price that makes me want to keep calling them back time and time again!

reviews.author: Lacie Boyea
reviews.text: I had a tree that was so close to my home I couldn’t believe they chopped it down without hitting anything. They were very friendly and professional. Gave me a great deal and got job done within a week of estimate.

reviews.author: Em Parente
reviews.text: Owner appears to have a lot going on right now. He provided a reasonable estimate and scheduled with me to do the work on multiple occasions, but then had other things come up. He returned my deposit when I found someone else to do the work.

reviews.author: Leslie Jones
reviews.text: Wonderful company to work with. Christian and his crew did an excellent job. Reasonably priced and finished the job ahead of schedule. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Nancy Young
reviews.text: The owner and staff are hard-working, reliable and courteous. They are flexible and take pride in their work. We are pleased with all the work they have done for us and continue to do. The icing on the cake: they are extremely reasonable. Call them first!

reviews.author: Jordan Hahnn
reviews.text: Christian is a small time business with a big output working load!!! They came and did my trees over the neighbors H.O.A. condo and the climber had the tree down in under 2 hours a 24inch wide oak in 30mph gusts!!! THESE GUYS ARE AWESOME!! CAN'T SAY ENOUGH

reviews.author: Bradley Brown
reviews.text: The lawn looked great, and the customer service was just as amazing. The team really went above and beyond our expectations at an unbeatable price. I would highly recommend this lawn care service over any other service for the Charlottesville/Albemarle area.

reviews.author: Bob Barry
reviews.text: I had used Christian for lawn care in the fall, but this time I needed snow removal for my long sloping driveway. My wife is disabled, and I can’t take any chances on not getting up to the house. Christian enthusiastically agreed to come to the house on short notice and did a fine job of clearing and salting the driveway. I will use this service again for sure. Bob B.

reviews.author: Jonah Jackson
reviews.text: Christian and his guys do a great job. They to good work at competitive prices and really care about doing a good job. The customer service is very good as well.

reviews.author: Bryan Paul
reviews.text: Reached out to this company via their website to have some simple landscaping done. Never heard back from them. Waste of time reaching out!Guess we will go with a company that has time for the little projects as well as the big. Terrible way to do business by leaving the customer hanging.

reviews.author: David Marsh
reviews.text: I called on a Wednesday and they showed up on Thursday. Great job - very professional. Wife was so happy we are now using them for weekly cutting! Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Georgia
reviews.text: Christian was very professional ,helpful with minor jobs outside his formal tasks.Very knowledgeable with trimming and landscaping in general.Very very friendly,did a Great job in our property!Weve hired him for a weekly maintenance !

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.text: I really appreciate Christian and his crew for the efficient work they did in removing three trees whose roots were interfering with our septic tank. Very friendly and great communication!

reviews.author: Mike Dantoni
reviews.text: Christian's Lawn Care is fantastic. They communicate well, are on time, call back, and do a great job - large or small. I'll keep using them!

reviews.author: Michael Cornelison
reviews.text: Went above and beyond with their service for an amazing price. They did more lawn than asked and refused to even talk about being paid a cent more when offered. I highly recommend everyone with a lawn to hire these guys

reviews.author: Kathleen Lennard
reviews.text: Christian was very responsive and handled leaf cleanup and hedging very professionally. He sent photos of progress. Great value!

reviews.author: al w
reviews.text: Christian was reasonable, prompt and easy to communicate with, you can tell he genuinely wants his customers to be satisfied from start to finish--highly recommended!

reviews.author: Cynthia Bowyer
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the exceptional work of Christian’s Lawn Care. Christian and his crew provided excellent, friendly service and were very affordable. I highly recommend Christian’s Lawn Care.

reviews.author: Scott Easton
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience dealing with them! From setting up service to paying them online, everything was made easy by their professionalism and business sense. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Kaylee Marie
reviews.text: The owner, Christian, is very professional and courteous. He makes sure he knows exactly what you’re looking for while also making sure his knowledge of what needs done is shared with you so that you have a clear understanding of what exactly is being done.

reviews.author: Karma
reviews.text: Excellent work for a very reasonable price. They show up when they say they will. Always polite and responsible. I recommend this company over others I have tried to do business with.

reviews.author: Eileen Donovan
reviews.text: I needed gutters cleaned before a storm and Christian Lawn Care came to the rescue. Their work was excellent and I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Diana
reviews.text: I am very pleased with their outstanding services. They are friendly, quick and efficient. My lawn is looking great and the price is very reasonable!

reviews.author: Fran Joseph
reviews.text: Unprofessional. After hiring him to mow and trim our yard, he was a no show for days, making several excuses each time. Finally ghosted us. Really. No response.

reviews.author: Arthur Rogers
reviews.text: Christian and his crew are really impressive. They work real hard and care about customer satisfaction. Great price too!!

reviews.author: Cindy Monroe
reviews.text: I definitely recommend, I had 7 trees cut down great prices on time and hard working, I want to thank the crew for all your hard work!

reviews.author: rogers hellman
reviews.text: As promised, Christian and crew showed up early am. This, in spite of the rain and 35 degree weather. They cleaned the gutters well and all at the agreed upon price.

reviews.author: Jordan Hahn
reviews.text: AWESOME service. Goes completely above and beyond everything I ask of him every time. His new tree climber is amazing to watch!!!!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: I highly recommend Christian's Lawn Care. Christian was incredibly responsive, he and his team did exactly what we asked, and his pricing was very reasonable. Thanks Christian!

reviews.author: deb baker
reviews.text: My property looks wonderful after Christians Lawn Care was here. I am so pleased. I definitely recommend!

reviews.author: joleen grace
reviews.text: They went above and beyond what I asked of them.Their pricing was reasonable, the men were totally professional and they were done with time to spare. would recommend them to anybody.

reviews.author: Dottey Sargeant
reviews.text: Did wonderful job on all my bushes and lawn. Will use them again the the future. They were all courteous.

reviews.author: Cynthia Early
reviews.text: owner kept me posted about scheduling around weather issues and made sure work was done to my satisfaction.

reviews.author: Brendan Anders
reviews.text: Just started using the service wind they have been very good. Very receptive. And available for service at a reasonable fee

reviews.author: Rachel Carter
reviews.text: These guy's are wonderful to work with... Great price's enthusiastic employee's very flexible and did I already mention the price's are unbeatable

reviews.author: Caitlin Henning
reviews.text: Great, fast service at a very fair price. I'll be using them again in the future for our lawn needs.

reviews.author: David Shalloway
reviews.text: Great folks, friendly service and a very good value. They got the job done on time, and it was a pleasure doing business with them!

reviews.author: Lori Gantt
reviews.text: Great guys and very hard workers. I was very impressed with this company and we recommend to all my friends.

reviews.author: KT Kimmal
reviews.text: Christian's Lawn Care was fantastic to work with! They came out to provide an estimate the same day I reached out and were able to take care of my lawn within two days. I was very impressed with his pricing and openness about the pricing process. My yard was very overgrown, but he had it looking great very quickly! I'm very happy with my experience!

reviews.author: Barry Bruce
reviews.text: After obtaining several cost estimates, I chose Christian's Lawn Care. He offered not only the best price but, also the best equipment to use for my rather small lawn areas. Instead of using heavy, ride-on machines, he is using regular mowers and string trimmers. His service includes mowing, edging, and blowing any debris. His crew is easy to work with and they will cut the grass at the height you prefer.
